Job description:
The Zisa marketing team is in development, and we are looking for a creative, up-to-date, and knowledgeable colleague in the world of Artificial Intelligence! If you know how to turn ideas into attractive content with the magic of prompts and are interested in creating content for websites and social media, there is a place for you in our team. Your duties and responsibilities at Zisa: Text Content Production: Writing attractive captions for social media, blog articles, and promotional texts using Artificial Intelligence tools (while adhering to brand tone and SEO principles). Creating Creative Images: Producing high-quality and exclusive images for Instagram posts, website banners, and article covers. Video Production: Creating, editing, and animating short and engaging videos with the help of Artificial Intelligence for posting on social networks. Social Media Management: Timely publishing of produced content on social media, responding to DMs and comments, managing website content, and proficiency in WordPress. Skills and qualities that are important to us: Complete mastery of Prompt Engineering. Mastery of text generation tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, etc.). Mastery of image generation tools (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, Leonardo, etc.). Familiarity with AI-powered video and audio generation and editing tools (such as Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, etc.). Mastery of social media and the algorithms related to Instagram and LinkedIn. Mastery of WordPress and working with website panels with a suitable graphic view and full understanding of the space of social networks and websites. High creativity, problem-solving approach, and enthusiasm for continuous learning of new tools. What Zisa offers you: A friendly, creative, and unconstrained work environment. A suitable space for implementing innovative ideas and personal growth. How to submit your resume: If you are ready to create value at Zisa with the help of Artificial Intelligence, we would be happy if you send your resume and portfolio. We await your creative presence at Zisa!

Company description:
Zisa Company has over 5 years of professional experience in the field of advertising and organizing specialized exhibitions in the building industry, Location: Niavaran-Saeedat Abad
